en: The postcard displays a sepia-toned image of a richly decorated Gothic reliquary, known as La Châsse de Sainte-Ursule (The Shrine of Saint Ursula). The shrine is highly detailed, featuring intricate gothic architectural details and narrative panel scenes. The bottom of the card contains printed text with the artifact's name and its location, referencing Bruges and the Saint John's Hospital.
